environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Quarkus native runtime, exposed via Lambda Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function URL resource-based policy specifies Action: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl with Condition: {"StringEquals": {"lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType": "AWS_IAM"}} and Principal restricted to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InternalAppRole. Unsigned requests or requests signed with credentials from any other principal receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service before the function is invoked. Note: the function code itself performs no authentication checks — the IAM auth enforcement occurs at the Lambda Function URL invocation layer, prior to handler execution. Additionally, the InternalAppRole trust policy restricts AssumeRole to a specific internal OIDC provider (accounts.internal.corp) with sub claim validation, meaning only authenticated internal employees can obtain temporary credentials for this role.

config.network: public internet (but IAM auth required at invocation layer)
